content.short_description: Infamous for its complete lack of collision physics and broken mechanics, a textbook example of unfinished game release.

content.values_findings: Values pulse: Assessment based on 7 critical factors
content.ethics_findings: Ethics pulse: Availability and support status: Delisted from Steam (2008)
